name: Pixelorama
description: Pixelorama's Extension Explorer obtains extension metadata from its configured raw GitHub HTTPS URL. For an entry, it downloads the supplied link to a local .pck path, compares the file's SHA-256 with the entry's supplied sha256 value, and installs only on a match; the manifest and link are not independently authenticated in this source review.
limitations: New default-branch snapshot rather than historical release re-verification; custom repository links, the remote manifest's provenance, server-side content controls, and released extension behavior remain unverified.
